sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.

Hides the Pro button on the home screen, the Pro banner and promotions on the Me tab, free trial tips in the editor and on export, and Plans & billing in Settings. Closes subscription pages before they show.
Removes the prompt to download the official app. Keeps saved app data.
Unlocks Pro filters, effects, templates and tools. AI features that use server credits are not unlocked.
